Name: TC-TIME_006(usability) : Verify readability and usability of employee reports
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
* Navigate to the OrangeHRM

system.
* Ensure the user is logged in with a valid Admin or Employee account.
* Ensure employee time records already exist in the system database.

* Valid Employee Name
* Valid Date Range
* Existing Employee Time Records
EXPECTED RESULTS
* System shall generate employee reports successfully.
* System shall display report information in a readable and organized
format.

consistency.
* System shall ensure that texts, tables, and filters are visible and
understandable.

* System shall preserve usability standards during report
visualization.
Objective:
This test case verifies that the Employee Reports module displays report
information in a clear, organized, and user-friendly manner when valid
employee data and filters are used. The test ensures that the report
layout, readability, navigation, and overall usability provide a good user
experience.
Expected Result:
* The OrangeHRM login page loads successfully.
* The login interface is displayed correctly.
* The user is authenticated successfully.

Name: TC_TIME_010(security): Verify data integrity by preventing unauthorized editing of generated Time Reports
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
* Pre-conditions: 1. Log in to OrangeHRM.

* 2. Ensure there is at least one generated report in the system
(e.g., "Employee Attendance Report").

* 3. Use a user account with "View" permissions but without
"Edit/Admin" permissions.


Requirements:

* System shall render report data as non-editable fields for
unauthorized roles.

* System shall not provide "Save", "Update", or "Edit" buttons within
the report view for these users.
Objective:
Objective: This test case verifies that once an Employee Report is
generated in the Time module, the data remains in a "Read-Only" state for
unauthorized users. It ensures that no one can manipulate the logs,
maintaining the "Single Source of Truth" for auditing purposes.
Step: Navigate to the Time module and select Reports
Expected Result: The Reports section loads and displays the list of available reports.

Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS 1. Navigate to the OrangeHRM system.

2. Ensure the user is logged in with a valid Admin or Employee account.

3. Ensure employee time records already exist in the system database for
testing.

4. Access the module: Time > Reports > Employee Reports.

REQUIREMENTS * Functional: Valid Employee Name and Valid Date Range.

* Data: Existing Employee Time Records (Attendance logs).

* Visual: Compliance with standard web accessibility (WCAG) for
contrast and font size.

EXPECTED RESULTS * Success: System shall generate employee reports
successfully upon clicking "View".

* Organization: System shall display report information in a readable,
tabular format with clear headers.

* Consistency: System shall maintain proper spacing, column alignment,
and visual consistency across all report rows.

* Clarity: System shall ensure that texts, tables, and filters are
high-contrast and easily understandable.

* Efficiency: System shall keep the interface responsive, allowing the
user to navigate large reports without UI breaking.

* Standardization: System shall preserve professional usability
standards (e.g., intuitive icons and clear data separation).
Objective:
This test case verifies that the Employee Reports module displays
information in a clear, organized, and user-friendly manner. The goal is to
ensure that the report layout, readability, and navigation follow
professional usability standards (UX/UI), providing an efficient experience
for the end user
Expected Result: System filters correctly.
